payload.comment: Preprocessing stage is internally consistent and well-documented. All structured data checks pass: (1) Split sizes (89996/10004/7180) match the official PathMNIST partition exactly; subsampled=false and profiled_fraction=1.0 confirm full-dataset usage. (2) Per-class counts sum correctly to split totals (89996, 10004, 7180). (3) Class proportions, imbalance ratios (train 1.634, test 3.947), and test-to-train prevalence ratios are arithmetically verified. (4) Channel statistics (mean [0.741, 0.533, 0.706], std [0.124, 0.177, 0.124]) are consistent between data_profile and representation_plan. (5) Augmentation math is correct: 89996 × 4 = 359984 matches split_manifest.augmented_train_size. (6) Normalization uses train-only stats (train_stats_only=true), preventing leakage. (7) Provenance hashes (archive_md5, per-split selected_index_sha256) are present and identical across dataset_manifest and split_manifest. (8) Test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is properly documented in both dataset_manifest and split_manifest. Two minor advisory notes: (a) The LLM-generated narrative in ambiguity_risks references '96×96 patch resolution' while the actual image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3]; this is a prose-only factual inconsistency — all structured numerical fields correctly report 28×28. (b) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama), meaning exact model weights are not pinned by content hash, which limits full reproducibility of LLM-assisted narrative generation. Neither issue affects the correctness of the preprocessing pipeline or the downstream training configuration. No deterministic findings were raised. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: LLM narrative in ambiguity_risks references '96×96 patch resolution' but actual image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3]; structured data is correct, prose-only inconsistency.
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); exact model weights not pinned by content hash, limiting full reproducibility of LLM-dependent narrative steps.

Test-set class distribution deviates substantially from train/val (adipose ×1.79, debris ×0.41, stroma ×0.56); per-class test metrics for debris (n=339), stroma (n=421), smooth muscle (n=592) will be statistically noisy — properly documented but worth monitoring downstream.
